[1] [2] It works in other technical consultancy (NACE 71.129, registered in Norwegian as “Annen teknisk konsulentvirksomhet”). [1] [3] Its own website describes it as: “Wyssen Avalanche Control utvikler og bygger skredtårn, programvare og deteksjonssystem for forebygging av snøskred.” [2] The register lists 5 employees (as of 2026-09-10). [1]

### Money
The latest filed annual accounts (2025) show revenue of NOK 39.2 m (up 107.4% from 2024), an operating result of NOK 4.1 m, a net result of NOK 3.4 m and equity of NOK 6.2 m. [4] That gives an operating margin of 10.4% and an equity ratio of 51.8% for 2025 (computed from the cited figures). [4] Revenue by filed year: 2023 NOK 15.1 m, 2024 NOK 18.9 m, 2025 NOK 39.2 m. [4] The Register of Company Accounts holds official copies of its filed accounts for 11 years (2015 to 2025), each linked as a PDF. [7]

### People and presence
The chief executive is Stian Langeland, the board is chaired by Christian Wyssen and 1 further board member is registered. [8] It has 2 registered workplaces in Sogndal and Tromsø. [9] Its verified website is https://www.wyssenavalanche.com/nb/; it links to company profiles on Facebook and Instagram. [2] No active ad was found on NAV's job feed, but its website links to a careers page. [2] Latest dated activity on its own channels: “100 år med Wyssen – Jubileumsfest 14.11.2026” (2026-07-09). [5]

### What changed
Since our previous run on 2026-10-24, nothing material has changed. Between the 2024 and 2025 accounts, revenue rose 107.4% (from NOK 18.9 m to NOK 39.2 m), the second rise in a row; the operating result turned from a loss of NOK 1.1 m to a profit of NOK 4.1 m. [4] The register's employee count was set to 6 on 2025-10-15, then 5 on 2026-09-14. [6] Its 2025 annual accounts were registered as filed on 2026-06-23. [6] The most recent registered change to its roles was on 2025-09-16 (auditor entry). [8]

### In brief
TOTO INDUSTRIER AS is a Bø-based private limited company, founded in 2005. [1] In 2025 it had revenue of NOK 1.3 m, up 1887.4% on 2024 and higher for the second year running, made an operating profit of NOK 228 k and had equity of NOK 1.8 m. [2] Recent changes: its board entry changed in the roles register on 2026-02-14. [3] Not found: a verified website, company-owned social profiles, active job ads and dated posts or news on its own channels.

### What it does
TOTO INDUSTRIER AS is a private limited company (AS) registered in Bø, founded 2005. [1] The register gives no industry for it (NACE 00.000, “Uoppgitt”). [1] Registered purpose: “Investering i- og omsetning av kapitalvarer, verdipapirer og andre virksomheter, herunder utvikling, utleie og investering i eiendom, samt forretningsorientert rådgivning og konsulenttjenester.” [1]

### Money
The latest filed annual accounts (2025) show revenue of NOK 1.3 m (up 1887.4% from 2024), an operating result of NOK 228 k, a net result of NOK 258 k and equity of NOK 1.8 m. [2] That gives an operating margin of 17.2% and an equity ratio of 11.3% for 2025 (computed from the cited figures). [2] Revenue by filed year: 2023 NOK 32 k, 2024 NOK 67 k, 2025 NOK 1.3 m. [2] The Register of Company Accounts holds official copies of its filed accounts for 15 years (2011 to 2025), each linked as a PDF. [4]

### People and presence
The chief executive is Linn Merete Torbjørnsen, the board is chaired by Torben Torbjørnsen and 1 further board member is registered. [3] It has 1 registered workplace in Sortland. [5]

### What changed
Since our previous run on 2026-10-24, nothing material has changed. Between the 2024 and 2025 accounts, revenue rose 1887.4% (from NOK 67 k to NOK 1.3 m), the second rise in a row; the operating result turned from a loss of NOK 921 k to a profit of NOK 228 k. [2] Its 2025 annual accounts were registered as filed on 2026-05-20. [6] The most recent registered change to its roles was on 2026-02-14 (board entry). [3] It was previously registered as LANGØEN INVEST AS (until 2006-02-16). [1]
